text: Core 3edea7d2, fix(immut/sorted_map): rebalance fully when join has an empty side. When one side of join is empty, join now walks the whole spine with add_min_entry/add_max_entry instead of doing one balance step, and split on disjoint keys hits that case. Measured locally on the same nightly with ref-cycle collection off, 3 interleaved rounds: eff799b0 ran 6.11-6.29us and HEAD ede6d1c8 ran 7.66-7.76us (+25%). 3edea7d2 is the only commit in that range that touches the merge path. This is the cost of a correctness fix: the old path built trees that broke the size-balance invariant (height 376 at 2000 entries).
